name: RTL Bench
description: Free MIT-licensed browser EDA workbench that synthesizes Verilog/SystemVerilog/VHDL into live gate schematics, simulates, runs STA on sky130/GF180/IHP and flashes Tang Nano/iCE40 boards.

name: LogicLab
description: Single-file browser logic simulator in Mano Digital Design style with clean uniform-time timing diagrams, flip-flops and cycle stepping for teaching.

name: Build Your Own ALU
description: Interactive page where you write real Nand2Tetris HDL in the browser to build 23 chips from a NAND gate up to an ALU.

name: Spade HDL
description: Modern Rust-inspired hardware description language with pipelines as a first-class construct, compiling to Verilog.

name: Veryl
description: Modern open-source HDL designed as a cleaner SystemVerilog alternative, with formatter, linter and language server, transpiling to SystemVerilog.

name: Bluespec Compiler (bsc)
description: Open-sourced Bluespec SystemVerilog/Haskell compiler and simulator for high-level, rule-based hardware design.

name: LibreLane
description: Community successor to OpenLane 2: a complete open-source RTL-to-GDSII ASIC flow built on Yosys, OpenROAD, Magic and KLayout.

name: SiliconCompiler
description: Python build system that drives open-source and commercial ASIC/FPGA flows from RTL to GDS with one portable script.

name: sv2v
description: Converts SystemVerilog to plain Verilog-2005 so SV designs work with Yosys, Icarus and other open tools.

name: slang
description: Fast, fully standards-compliant SystemVerilog compiler and library for parsing, elaboration and linting.

name: Icestudio
description: Visual block-based editor for open FPGA boards (iCE40, ECP5) built on the open toolchain, great for beginners.

name: Apio
description: One-command CLI that installs the open FPGA toolchain and builds, simulates and uploads designs to dozens of iCE40/ECP5/Gowin boards.

name: openFPGALoader
description: Universal open-source utility for programming Xilinx, Intel, Lattice, Gowin and other FPGAs over many cable types.

name: FuseSoC
description: Package manager and build abstraction for HDL IP cores, letting one core description target many simulators and FPGA tools.

name: VUnit
description: Open-source unit-testing framework for VHDL and SystemVerilog with test runner, CI integration and verification components.

name: pyuvm
description: UVM implemented in Python on top of cocotb, bringing industry-style verification methodology to open simulators.

name: MIT 6.205 Digital Systems Laboratory
description: MIT's full FPGA lab course site with lecture notes, SystemVerilog labs and project write-ups, free to read online.

name: Chipyard
description: Berkeley's framework for building full RISC-V SoCs in Chisel, from simulation and FPGA prototyping to VLSI tape-out.

name: Konnect
description: Rust native KiCad 10 plugin exposing 170+ schematic, layout, routing and review tools to Claude or any LLM via MCP (AGPL-3.0, free for individuals).

name: KiCadRoutingTools
description: Python/Rust KiCad routing plugin with differential pairs, length matching, plane and via placement, aimed beyond traditional autorouters.

name: pcb-toolkit
description: MIT Rust library and CLI of PCB calculators (trace impedance, current capacity, vias) compatible with Saturn PCB Toolkit, each stating its model's validity range.

name: Synth (Abstract Machines)
description: Apache-2.0 circuit compiler that turns text-based board descriptions into KiCad schematics, layouts and BOMs, with agent tooling.

name: CERN KiCad Component Library
description: CERN opened its complete KiCad component library for anyone designing boards, announced May 2026.

name: mcp-server-kicad
description: 109 MCP tools letting an AI assistant edit real KiCad schematics, layouts, ERC/DRC and exports without corrupting files (maintenance mode).

name: KiCad AI Assistant
description: KiCad plugin embedding an LLM chat panel with a built-in MCP server to edit schematics and placement in natural language (KiCad 10).

name: kicad-tools
description: Standalone Python tools to parse and manipulate KiCad schematic and PCB files, with an A* router and placement optimizer.

name: StripForge
description: Beta KiCad 10 plugin for laying out stripboard/veroboard projects inside KiCad.

name: TraceMaker router benchmark (PUNKFAB)
description: Practical benchmark write-up of TraceMaker, a new open-source C++/CUDA KiCad autorouter, against a commercial router.

name: OSHWA Open Source Hardware Definition
description: The community definition of open source hardware that underpins OSHWA certification.

name: Seeed OPL KiCad Library
description: Seeed Studio's open parts library of KiCad symbols and footprints for parts stocked in its fabrication service.

name: TinyGo
description: Go compiler for microcontrollers and WebAssembly supporting many boards.

name: TinyUSB
description: Open-source cross-platform USB host/device stack for embedded systems.

name: probe-rs
description: Rust-based debugging and flashing toolkit for ARM and RISC-V targets.

name: CMSIS 6
description: Arm's open vendor-independent software interface for Cortex-M microcontrollers.

name: Unity Test
description: Lightweight C unit-testing framework designed for embedded firmware.

name: OpenThread
description: Open-source implementation of the Thread mesh networking protocol.

name: matter.js
description: TypeScript implementation of the Matter smart-home protocol.

name: mruby
description: Lightweight embeddable Ruby for resource-constrained devices.

name: BasicMAC LoRaWAN
description: Open LoRaWAN MAC stack for microcontroller end nodes.

name: Mbed OS
description: Open-source embedded OS for connected Arm Cortex-M devices.
